title: Disappointing
text:
I have subscribed to this box for over two years and it was my favorite day of the month when it arrived. It was, and is, a well curated box with few, if any, repeats. However, Allure killed all the good will they garnished in the last years with this price increase of over 50%. I gave them 2 stars because they still do a good job editorially, just a poor job with the size and quantity of products in the box.

I received a notice toward the end of summer the price would be increasing in October, but there would be X, X, and X to increase the value of the box. Honestly, I forgot until November’s box that it was supposed to be changing because nothing has appeared to change. This month’s box seemed pretty spare which inspired me to double check the charge and I have indeed been charged $25/month since October. Somebody got greedy here! Cancelled my subscription and am trying a different subscription box.
label: negative
